run_order: canonical for byte reproducibility; paired traces are identical across methods

power_decision.basis: Phase 0 planning floor retained after feasibility pilot; report confidence intervals and sensitivity, not post-hoc power.
power_decision.increase_rule: Increase before unblinding only if pilot exposes degenerate variance or infrastructure instability.

multiplicity_control: Holm across preregistered H1-H3 and H5-H9 comparisons
continuous_test: paired sign-flip permutation with deterministic bootstrap confidence interval

primary_comparisons.safety_guard: mean invariant violations must not increase

exclusion_policy: No outcome-based exclusions. Infrastructure failures remain recorded and are classified before rerun.
acceptance_policy: The Phase 8 gate requires protocol integrity, complete execution, deterministic reproduction, and honest reporting. It does not require hypotheses to be favorable.
scientific_boundary: Accelerated synthetic hospital-resilience simulation and host-specific engineering measurements only; no clinical efficacy, patient-safety, production-scale, hardware-root, or universal causal claim.
